notes.title: Zerone Update Note 2024.01.18
notes.content:
Hello users.
We are very excited to tell you about the addition of Tutorial Mode!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39216259/a1719b4d1eb0350e495440fc0b8f1f2594182cef.png[/img]

You can now enter the tutorial map through How to Play? at the top of the game's main menu.

The tutorial map provides explanations on how to control and operate each character.
You can also learn how to attack enemy units within the map.

Learn how to control each character through the tutorial and defeat imperial units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39216259/3ab1c8600e463f30284e8ebc41d698065f93faaa.png[/img]

Once the contents related to the next update are somewhat organized, we will come back with an announcement about the scheduled update.

thank you

We are always looking for your feedback!
Please support our first game and give us feedback.
We are always open!

notes.title: Zerone Update Note 2024.01.10
notes.content:
Zerone Update Note 2024.01.10

Hello users.
You've waited a long time!
The planned improvements announced in the previous notice are
Some parts have been completed and updated.

I'm sorry for not being able to deliver it to you sooner.

These are the major improvements made with this update.

1. Balance adjustment
2. Change in hit judgment
3. PVE content structure changes
4. Deleting Clasher's booster

Currently, these four contents have been updated
You can find a detailed explanation in the content below.

1. Balance adjustment
Our game does not have a difficulty selection.
At a time when there were more new users than experienced users, we decided that a difficult difficulty level would not be good in the long run.
The play difficulty has been significantly lowered so that new users can enjoy it lightly.

2. Change in hit judgment
All boss units in PVP and PVE have hitboxes limited to the core.
If the core is not hit, no damage is done to the boss unit.
I think this is a bad decision based on my experience with FPS before VR.
A hitbox has been applied to the entire body, and damage is now inflicted no matter where you hit.
Of course, hitting the core will cause more damage!

3. PVE content structure changes
Unlike the current situation where only bosses appeared, the structure change from normal monsters to boss monsters has been completed.
The time allotted for one round has been increased, and as you quickly deal with regular monsters, you can hit boss monsters with more time than before.
I think the changed structure of PVE will help you master the controls and help you break records compared to before!

4. Delete Clasher character booster
Until now, Clasher was able to use the Gunner's unique skill, Dash, as well as its unique energy shield.
We removed the Clasher's dash and increased the shield size to preserve the characteristics of the Clasher and Gunner.
Now, the Clasher will be a character that focuses on close-range attacks and defense, and the Gunner will be a character that focuses on long-range attacks and quick mobility through dashing.

I think that new users will be able to access the game more easily through the four contents above.
We apologize once again for the late update.

The next update is also scheduled to feature features that are more easily accessible to new users.
We are planning changes to the game tutorial and character information panel.

More details about the next update will be provided in the next patch notes.

We are always looking for your feedback!
Please support our first game and give us feedback.
We are always open!

Thank You!

notes.title: Zerone Notice 2024.01.04[EN]
notes.content:
Happy New Year! Everyone!
Thank you very much to everyone who is interested in Zerone.
We have been testing the game with the help of many people since launch.
We thought of making it a game for beginners, but testers and users found it difficult, and it was decided that it would not be as easy as we thought for new users.
We are preparing several updates to improve this.

1. Difficulty adjustment
2. Change in hit judgment
3. Tutorial
4. Changes to the current PVE content structure
5. Addition of new PVE content
6. Additional characters and additional bosses

All updates are being developed as quickly as possible! It's hard to give an exact date, but we will make a lot of improvements within January.
Please support us and give us feedback!
Our Discord is always open.

1. Difficulty adjustment
Unfortunately, our game does not have difficulty control.
We judged that our game, which does not have difficulty control, may be difficult for users, and we are working on improving the difficulty level.

2. Change in hit judgment
Currently, the boss monster's hitting point is limited to the central core.
However, due to the nature of VR, we judged that it would not be easy to continuously hit only a certain portion of the target.
If this part is improved and updated, a hit box will be created on the entire monster, making it easier to hit.
Of course, hitting the core will cause more damage.

3. Tutorial
We thought our game had simple controls, so we uploaded the tutorial to YouTube and didn't provide any other tutorials in the game.
However, we thought that the lack of a tutorial in the game would cause a lot of difficulty in first operation, so we plan to provide a tutorial so that you can learn how to operate the game in an easy way.

4. Changes to the current PVE content structure
We are improving the PVE game structure and progression through feedback from testers and users.
Unlike now, where only bosses appear, development is underway with a structure that progresses from normal monsters to boss monsters.
I think the changed structure of PVE will help you master the controls and help you break records compared to before!

5. Addition of new PVE content
Currently, there is only one type of content, PVE and PVP.
The goal of improved PVE is to help you become proficient in our game, and the new PVE content is content with a difficult difficulty that experienced users can challenge.
Through this, we plan to plan events such as ranking events.

6. Additional characters and additional bosses
Currently, there are two types of characters: Gunner and Clasher, and bosses that appear in PVE.
We are currently planning to add one type of supporter-type player character and one type of dinosaur-type robot that we had previously planned.
We are trying to proceed with development as quickly as possible, but I think it will take quite a long time due to the company's circumstances.
It may take longer than you think. I'm sorry, please understand.

This is something that will definitely be updated over time!
You can be sure. It might be the difference between being early or late.

Once again Happy New Year! Everyone!

thank you

notes.title: patch Notes for 12/19/2023
notes.content:
Now, with the use of the right controller's stick or touchpad, rotational movement is possible. 
This allows for smooth gameplay even during wired play.
